subject: Kraken
text: Kraken has 600 HP and is weak against lightning.

evidence.quote: HP-600...He does cast LIT2/3 sometimes (seems odd seeing as he's weak against it), and that can hurt.

subject: Kraken
text: Kraken can hit 8 times for over 400 damage, so defense should begin with 2 to 3 layers of INV2, followed by ALIT for LIT3, and FAST on attackers.

evidence.quote: He will be able to get 8 hits on you at once, and nail you for over 400 damage sometimes, enough to send a White/Black Wizard or a weak Master to the floor in a hurry....Since his attack is clearly the biggest threat, start with 2-3 layers of INV2 to help reduce his attack power.  After about 3 shots of INV2, the biggest threat now will be LIT3.  Cast ALIT to nullify the danger of that.  Follow that up by FASTing your warriors, then continue with INV2 and healing.

subject: Dr. Unne
text: Taking the SLAB to Dr. Unne in Melmond allows the party to learn the Lefeinish language.

evidence.quote: To save you the effort of coming here in vain, take the SLAB to Dr. Unne in Melmond.  He will teach you the Lefeinish language.

subject: Magic shop
text: A secret magic shop in the upper-right section of Lefein sells NUKE and LIF2.

evidence.quote: If you didn't figure it out by now, or you didn't know already, there is a secret Magic shop in the upper-right part of town....Find the notch in the gate and head to the right to get NUKE and LIF2.

subject: Lefein citizen
text: Talking to the person in the bottom left corner of Lefein yields the CHIME used to unlock Mirage Tower.

evidence.quote: However, all you really need to do is go to the top, head right, down, and talk to the guy standing still on the bottom left corner.  He will give you the CHIME to unlock the Mirage Tower.

subject: Chimera
text: Chimeras use BLAZE for fire damage and are weak against Ice.

evidence.quote: You will also see Chimeras.  They will use BLAZE on you (or something to that effect), which will cause Fire damage....They are weak against Ice if you are inclined to use magic.

subject: Mirage Tower 1F
text: The first floor of Mirage Tower contains the Thor Hammer, which casts LIT3 when used in battle.

evidence.quote: Head into the treasure room on the first floor where you'll find some interesting yet simple mazes to get tons of cool treasure....You will also find the best weapon (save the Masmune) for the White Wizard, the Thor Hammer.  You can actually hurt an enemy with this if you Attack (unlike other hammers), or USE it to cast LIT3, a great choice for undead or sea creatures.

subject: Sky Castle 1F
text: The first floor of Sky Castle contains the Bane Sword, which casts BANE when used in battle.

evidence.quote: As you progress up to the first floor of the Sky Castle, you will find the Bane Sword among other things.  The Sword itself is rather weak, but it casts BANE in battle, which will wipe out a whole group of enemies provided it works.

subject: Sky Castle 2F
text: The southwest branch of Sky Castle 2F contains ADAMANT, which can be given to the dwarf blacksmith in Dwarf Cave to forge Excalibur.

evidence.quote: On the next floor, you will find the ADAMANT on the southwest branch, which you need to give to the Dwarf Blacksmith in the Dwarf Cave (as if you couldn't figure out where it was) to get the Xcalbur, the best weapon that the Knight alone can use.

subject: Sky Castle 2F
text: The southwest corner of Sky Castle 2F contains the White Shirt, which casts INV2 when used in battle.

evidence.quote: On the southwest corner, you will find the White Shirt, which only the White Wizard can equip, which he should....This wonder-cotton blouse casts INV2 when you USE it in battle, which is one of the most useful defensive spells in the game.

subject: Sky Castle 2F
text: Beside the White Shirt is a black-dyed shirt that casts ICE2 when used in battle.

evidence.quote: Right next to this treasure chest is another White Shirt, only this time dyed black, and is complementary color Wizard.  The magic black dye in here causes ICE2 to be cast in battle when USEd instead of INV2.

subject: Sky Castle upper floor
text: An upper treasure floor of Sky Castle contains a Katana.

evidence.quote: One more level up, you will find some second-rate treasure compared to what you got before....Other things on this floor include more second-rate stuff and a Katana, the ideal weapon for the Ninja.

subject: Mirage Tower teleporter
text: Entering Sky Castle through the teleporter in Mirage Tower requires the CUBE.

evidence.quote: Head up to the teleporter.  You can't get through here unless you have the CUBE.  You will now be in the sky castle.

subject: Sky Castle maze room
text: In the looping grid maze floor of Sky Castle, move right 2 spaces and up 2 spaces to reach the teleporter.

evidence.quote: This next room seems rather weird, it's really a maze, more of a grid than anything.  The weird thing is, that it overlaps, so if you go too far one way, you will end up on the other side, much like the Airship on the world map.  Go right 2 spaces and up 2 spaces, or zig-zag until you find the up-arrow-teleporter-stair-thing.

subject: WarMech
text: WarMech has 1000 HP, 50 Absorb, hits for 200 to 400 damage or casts NUCLEAR for up to 400 damage, and yields 32,000 GP and 32,000 EXP upon defeat.

evidence.quote: HP-1000...He has 50 Absorb, which can be quite hard to handle....WarMech is much different.  He either attacks for 200-400 damage, or he uses NUCLEAR, which does up to 400 damage to you whole party....You will be well rewarded-32,000 GP and 32,000 EXP.

subject: Tiamat
text: Tiamat has 1000 HP, 50 defense, uses instant-kill attacks counterable by ProRings or ARUB, and uses THUNDER and POISON attacks.

evidence.quote: HP-1000...He has some nasty auto-kill attacks, so equip ProRings beforehand or cast ARUB.  He also has a THUNDER attack, a nasty move that's like LIT3, only more powerful.  He can also use POISON a nasty damaging attack....He has 50 defense like WarMech, so only high level fighters will beuseful for hand/sword-to-whatever-he-has.
